description: Add a task pack from list_task_packs to the household: creates its tasks, repeating tasks and events, dated from the anchor date. The pack's titles are English: when the user is not writing in English, pass their titles (and notes) translated in overrides. Returns how many of each were created.

anchorDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, at most 5 years ahead. Required for a pack with isTargetDatePack true: the target date the items count back from (e.g. moving day or due date); ask the user if they haven't said. Otherwise the date the pack starts; omit to use the linked entity's date from list_task_packs, or today. Items that would fall in the past are moved to today.

entityId.description: Required for packs with a relatedEntityType (vehicle, appliance or pet packs): the id of one of the pack's entities from list_task_packs. Omit for other packs.

itemIds.description: The items to add. Omit to add the items selected by default.

items.description: One item id from the pack's items in list_task_packs.

overrides.description: Replacement text for added items. When the user is not writing in English, give every added item its title (and notes) translated into their language.

items.description: The replacement title and/or notes for one item.

itemId.description: An item id from the pack's items in list_task_packs.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/London, used to place timed events and to decide today. Omit to use the user's saved time zone.

name: apply_task_pack
